message:
T-3041: account for parade slabs owned by native grounds (#1696)

Separate only the two explicitly owned parade slabs from the direct building
roll after their actual loaded meshes prove nonempty, finite, nondegenerate
and entirely earth. Keep failed loads, invalid meshes, mixed sundial geometry
and unowned ordinary buildings in the existing presence checks.

Preserve original material roles across shared batching. The real fenced-ground
layer already renders independently; do not fabricate a building box or add to
the standing count. Add production-loader regression coverage and retain all
existing fort-gate checks.

Local source parts 1-3 passed on unchanged authored tree 44ce86cc; part 4
passed after the native instrument added the required read-only measurement
for the new fixture. Only that generated inventory changed between the runs. Actual viewport/native validation and final hosted
gate still follow. T-3041 and parent T-2387 remain partial; no image-match
completion or restored-ground claim is made.

Co-authored-by: polecat-steward <steward@polecat.live>
